title: BCCDC-PHL/threshold pipeline - params.project_alignment_refs schema
description: Reference genome per project: one row per project_id. The reference is an NCBI assembly accession (GCF_/GCA_...) or a path to a local FASTA, as in the samplesheet's reference column.

project_id.errorMessage: project_id may only contain letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens and dots (as in the samplesheet)

reference.errorMessage: reference should be an NCBI assembly accession (GCF_/GCA_...) or a path to a FASTA file, with no spaces
